title: Long-Term Compressive Behavior Evaluation for SSC and Prediction Using Machine Learning Models with SHAP Interpretation.
summary: Measurements through 720 days from 344 observations were used to train and evaluate BP-family, bagging and gradient-boosting models for seawater sea-sand concrete strength. Held-out predictions had reported R² values around 0.81–0.88, with age ranked highly by SHAP; the result is limited to this dataset.
ai_technology: BP-family neural networks; bagging; gradient boosting; SHAP
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Measured compressive strength through 720 days for 344 observations; held-out model R² was about 0.81–0.88.
evidence.unknown: One study dataset and held-out evaluation do not establish performance across independently produced concrete mixtures or field structures.
